mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL (inflation) and decreases in INDPRO (industrial output) signal stagflationary conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.3% and INDPRO falls by at least 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0% and increasing for two consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and FEDFUNDS increases for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months during monetary tightening cycles as defined by the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand for residential construction, which correlates with higher consumer spending and corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where HOUST increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 99.5% (relative to the previous month) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where INDPRO falls below 99.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where both HOUST and RSAFS increase by at least 0.3% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (defined by UNRATE below 5.0% and rising for two consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to impending monetary tightening and economic overheating.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5.0% and UNRATE increases for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months during late-cycle expansions as defined by the trigger condition.
